text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*, *wheeze*... *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The end of summer.
Furioso's face looked completely haggard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toward an uncompromising, decisive battle.
Proof of how harshly I pushed myself this summer...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—I'm fine. This is what I wanted. Besides,
unless I go this far, I won't stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: If I don't stake my life on it, there's no way I can reclaim the pride of Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I have done all that can be done.
All that remains are the final touches..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I have to cut off... any path of emotional retreat.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Furioso-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're in great shape.
Put on the best race for us this autumn, okay?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Well, go ahead and act cocky while you can.
I'll be catching right up to you in no time.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san, Espo-san.
I need to speak with you both.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Um... regarding this autumn,
with the two of you—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Please give me some space.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? The distance?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes. To both of them, um... I am truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Funabashi and the JRA. Though our affiliations were different,
they still treated me so well in so many ways.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: However, this autumn, we must harden our hearts. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone in the JRA is an enemy."
Unless I approach it with that level of resolve,
I don't think I stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"This is a special request...
so that the two of us can achieve
our ultimate goal in coming to the Central."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"This autumn, please...
don't cheer for me."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I told you... not to cheer for me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I listened in silence.
Even so, I understood Furioso's feelings well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By nature, Furioso wasn't the type of person
who could hate anyone. Which is exactly why...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Furioso-san, but, um...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"The circle of friendship is important, you know.
So please don't say things like that..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Understood.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh, Espo-san?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't actually cheering for her
in the first place or nothin'.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm not lifting a finger to help for a while.
In fact, quite the opposite—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume of the Central, I'll take their side!
I'm rooting for Crimson Nova.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Espo-san!? No way...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Shut up!
This is fine as it is.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Just as you wish, I'll go all the way.
So—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't leave behind even a single fragment of regret.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Espo-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Trading barbs back and forth, Espoir City and Smart Falcon walked away.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This is fine.
With this――I can fight without holding anything back.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let us pour everything we have into this.
All the feelings we've held for years.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This inferiority complex I could never shake off...
We must redeem all our shared regrets.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Defeat the JRA. For that, defeating
Crimson Nova is an absolute necessity."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let us turn that tragedy into the past.
With our own strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sea is still crimson today.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow's sea will surely be blue.
That's what I believe."
